title: 14-BCV-004 - Spans for joists, rafters and beams

facts.text: The STANDATA cites ABC Article 9.23.4.2 for maximum permissible spans of joists, rafters and beams.
It permits the values in The Span Book (2009 Edition) to be used to determine those maximum spans; the document states province-wide applicability.
